entities.name: Gate to the Afterlife
entities.description: A massive river gate on the Luxa near Naktamun on Amonkhet, a sacred passage for the bodies of the worthy.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: A city on Amonkhet near the Gate to the Afterlife.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane where the Gate stood.

entities.name: Luxa
entities.description: The river on whose banks the Gate stood.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The ruler who promised paradise to the worthy dead.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A goddess who ritually slew those who completed the Five Trials.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Undead warriors who emerged from the Crypt of the Eternals when the gate opened.

entities.name: Crypt of the Eternals
entities.description: The massive crypt revealed when the Gate to the Afterlife swung open.

entities.name: Hour of Revelation
entities.description: The event in which the Gate was foretold to open completely.

events.summary: Those who complete the Five Trials are ritually slain by Hazoret and sent down the Luxa through the Gate.
events.quote: Those who completed the Five Trials and earned the highest honor were ritually slain at the hands of the goddess Hazoret herself

events.summary: When the Final Hours come, the Gate swings open by itself, revealing the Crypt of the Eternals rather than paradise.
events.quote: it revealed not a waiting paradise, but the massive Crypt of the Eternals

events.summary: The Eternals emerge to bring death and ruin.
events.quote: the silent ranks of the Eternals emerged to bring death and ruin instead of eternal rest

relations.quote: near the outer edge of the city of Naktamun
